info.title: Name That LLM: Qwen3-8B LoRA + Claude Head
info.subtitle: Qwen3-8B LoRA + within-Claude head; fold0 0.493, LB 0.552 in blend
info.description:
# Qwen3-8B LoRA for Name That LLM (with an auxiliary within-Claude head)

A LoRA fine-tune of **Qwen3-8B-Base truncated to 24 layers** for the [Name That LLM](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/name-that-llm) competition. It follows the public lora24 design (mean pools of layers 2/4/6/8/12/16/20/24, per-layer LayerNorm, linear heads, same-prompt triplets, plain + prompt-centered 18-way heads) and adds one thing: a **5-way within-Claude head** trained on the original Claude rows **plus** the free public [Extra API Passages](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/seyitkaangunes/ntl-extra-api-passages).

The 18-way heads only ever see original competition data, so the API prompts' topics can't leak into the 18-way decision.

## Held-out results (same 539 validation rows as the public lora24 `outer0` fold)

| Model | balanced accuracy |
|---|---|
| public lora24, plain head | 0.4559 |
| **this LoRA, plain head** | **0.4838** |
| **this LoRA + Claude-head gate** | **0.4932** |

**Public LB:** added as a third LoRA to the 0.549 LoRA x Adaptive Centering blend together with Claude gates, it scores **0.552**. See [0.552 | Adaptive Centering + Own LoRA + Claude Gates](https://www.kaggle.com/code/zbigniewkirchner/0-552-adaptive-centering-own-lora-claude-gates).

Within-Claude accuracy on true Claude rows: 0.63 (plain head restricted to Claude) -> **0.69** (Claude head).

## Files
* `final/`: fit on all 2,699 training rows. **Use this one for inference.** It contains `adapter/` (PEFT), `heads.safetensors` (the 8 LayerNorms), `readouts.npz` (`plain_*`, `center_*`, `claude_*` coefficients), `tokenizer/` and `anchor_features.npz` (features of train rows 0-2, for a parity check).
* `fold0/`: the validation fit plus `validation_features.npz`.

Base model: attach `qwen-lm/qwen-3/Transformers/8b-base/1`. Inference is a drop-in for the `lora_plain_proba` function of the public LoRA x Adaptive Centering notebooks. Point the glob at this dataset's `final/COMPLETE.json` (e.g. `/kaggle/input/**/ntl-qwen3-8b-lora-claude-head/**/final/COMPLETE.json`), and use `claude_coef`/`claude_intercept` to choose *which* Claude when the blend predicts Claude.

Training notebook: [ntl lora24 claude aux](https://www.kaggle.com/code/zbigniewkirchner/ntl-lora24-claude-aux).
